app.name: Ella
app.tagline: A model-testing workbench for Blockbench authors
logs.empty: Nothing yet. Launch the game to see its output here.
logs.noMatch: No line matches the current filter.
home.welcomeText: Model a block in Blockbench, save, and watch it change in the running game. Five steps and you are live.
home.projectSubtitle: Namespace {namespace}. Everything you make lands under it.
home.noLiveVersion: None of your installed versions can live-edit, so the game will launch but never pick up your changes.
home.action.editorText: Tune a block's look and behaviour while the game runs.
home.action.newText: Add another block or item to the project.
home.action.exportText: Package everything as a resource pack zip.
home.action.logsText: Read what the game and the launcher are saying.
home.resume: Pick up where you left off
home.resumeHelp: Opening one of these puts its blocks and items back in the editor and reloads them into a running game.
home.newProjectText: Start a fresh namespace of your own.
guide.title: Getting set up
guide.subtitle: Ella needs all five of these before an edit in Blockbench can reach the running game. Each one checks itself — nothing here is a box you tick.
guide.version.title: Install a Minecraft version
guide.version.why: Ella downloads and manages its own copy, so nothing it does can touch your normal installation.
guide.project.title: Create a project
guide.project.why: A project holds your models, textures and settings, and gives them the namespace the game loads them under.
guide.entry.title: Add a block or an item
guide.entry.why: Ella writes a starter model and texture for it, ready to open in Blockbench.
guide.blockbench.title: Point Ella at Blockbench
guide.blockbench.why: Ella hands Blockbench the very model file the game reads, so saving is the update — there is no import or export in between.
guide.launch.title: Launch the game
guide.launch.why: Ella's mod connects back to the launcher on startup. Once it does, every save appears in game without a reload.
status.adapter: Running version, loader and Ella adapter
versions.title: Minecraft version
versions.subtitle: Ella keeps its own installations, separate from the official launcher.
versions.recommendedHelp: These versions have an Ella adapter built, so edits reach the running game. Any other version installs and launches, but only as plain Minecraft.
versions.noneInstalledHelp: Pick one from the list below. The first install downloads a few hundred megabytes; later ones reuse most of it.
versions.javaFoundHelp: A matching Java runtime was found on this machine.
versions.vanillaOnlyHelp: No Ella adapter covers this version, so it launches as plain Minecraft.
versions.noneInstalled: No version installed yet. Install one below to get started.
versions.uninstallRemoves: Removes the version files, its natives and its Forge install — about {size}.
versions.uninstallKeepsShared: Libraries and assets are shared with your other versions and are kept.
versions.uninstallWorlds: Also delete worlds, options and the mods folder ({size})
versions.uninstallWorldsWarning: Your worlds for this version will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
versions.inUse: Stop the game before uninstalling this version
versions.unsupported: Ella does not support this version
versions.unsupportedReason: JSON models were introduced in 1.8, so there is nothing to test below it.
versions.javaMissing: Java {java} was not found on this machine
versions.repairHelp: Download anything missing again — keeps your worlds and settings.
quick.title: Quick launch
quick.noVersions: Install a version to launch from here.
quick.vanillaOnly: No adapter for this version — launches without live editing.
quick.projectTargetsMissing: This project is made for {version}, which is not installed.
project.title: Project
project.newSubtitle: A project is one namespace and everything under it — your models, your textures and the settings for each one.
project.nameRequired: Give the project a name first
project.noEntriesHelp: Add a block or an item and Ella writes a starter model and texture you can open straight in Blockbench.
project.noProjectHelp: Projects keep your models, textures and settings together under one namespace.
project.name: Name
project.namespaceHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Used in resource paths.
project.targetVersionHelp: The version this project is authored for. It is preselected when the project is opened, and launching another one asks first.
project.targetVersionNone: Not bound yet — the next launch decides
project.namespaceChangeWarning: Renaming “{from}” to “{to}” moves your asset folder and rewrites the texture references inside your models. Anything outside this project that points at the old namespace will not follow.
project.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes {entries} block(s)/item(s) and {files} of your own model and texture files. It cannot be undone.
project.noProject: Open or create a project to start modelling.
entry.previewRotate: Drag to turn the model · double-click to reset
entry.kind.block.help: Placed in the world. Has a hitbox, a hardness and a render layer.
entry.kind.item.help: Held in the hand or the inventory. Simpler, and always available.
entry.needsSlot: Not bound to a slot — restart the game to bind it
entry.deleteExplain: The entry is removed and its slot freed. Your model and texture files are kept unless you tick the box below.
entry.deleteFiles: Also delete its model and texture files
entry.deleteFilesWarning: The model JSON and texture PNG will be permanently deleted.
texture.title: Textures
texture.particleHelp: The texture the game uses for break and step particles.
texture.orphanedFaces: Removed “{key}”, but these faces still reference it and will fail to load: {faces}
model.source.objUnavailable: OBJ support is not implemented yet
model.parentTrap: This model inherits from {parent}, which on Minecraft 1.8.x replaces its own {count} shape(s) with the parent's — so it renders as a plain cube in game.
model.parentRemoved: Removed the {parent} parent — your own shapes now render.
compat.title: Launch on a different version?
compat.subtitle: “{project}” is made for {from}, and you are about to launch {to}.
compat.noIssues: Nothing in this project needs changing for {to}.
compat.automatic: The pack format and the slot files are regenerated for whichever version connects, so those need nothing from you.
compat.adoptAndFix: Move this project to {to} and rewrite {count} model file(s)
compat.oneOff: Left unticked, this run is a one-off: the project stays on {from} and its files are not touched.
compat.issue.parentOverridesGeometry: Its {parent} parent wins over the model's own geometry before 1.9 — it would render as the parent instead.
compat.issue.vanillaTextureFolder: Refers to the vanilla texture {reference}, which on {to} is called {expected} — it would show the missing-texture checkerboard.
compat.note.noAdapter: No Ella adapter covers {version}, so live editing will not work there.
compat.note.plannedAdapter: The adapter for {version} is planned but not built yet, so live editing will not work there.
compat.note.losesLiveEditing: {from} supports live editing and {to} does not — edits will stop reaching the game.
compat.note.javaMissing: {version} needs Java {java}, and no matching runtime was found.
settings.block.renderLayer.help: How the block's faces are drawn. Anything other than Solid also needs Occludes neighbours turned off.
settings.block.opaque.help: When on, faces of adjacent blocks are culled. Turn it off for any transparent block.
settings.block.emissive.help: Draws the block at full brightness regardless of light level.
settings.block.tintIndex.help: Colour index applied to tinted faces. -1 disables tinting.
settings.block.lightLevel.help: Light emitted by the block, 0 to 15.
settings.block.hardness.help: Time to break. -1 makes the block unbreakable.
settings.block.fullCube.help: Turn off for any model that does not fill its whole block space.
settings.block.hitbox.help: Bounds in model space, 0 to 16 on each axis.
settings.block.rotation.help: How the block orients itself when placed. Your model should face north; the game turns it.
settings.item.handheld.help: Uses the handheld model parent, angled in the hand.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Where Ella finds your tools, and how much room it reserves in game.
settings.usernameHelp: The name Ella launches Minecraft under. Offline only — no account is involved.
settings.blockbenchPlaceholder: Leave empty to detect it automatically
settings.blockbenchMissing: Ella could not find Blockbench. Set the path here, or install it from blockbench.net.
settings.javaHelp: Ella picks the right runtime per Minecraft version. Old versions need Java 8; recent ones need 17 or 21.
settings.javaNone: No Java runtime was found, so no version can be launched. Install a JDK and reopen Ella.
settings.slotPoolHelp: How many blocks and items are reserved at startup. Higher costs nothing but needs a restart to change.
warning.transparentButOpaque: This render layer draws transparency, but the block still occludes its neighbours, so it will look solid in game. Turn off Occludes neighbours.
warning.nonOpaqueSolidLayer: The block does not occlude neighbours but uses the Solid layer, so transparent pixels will render black. Switch to Cutout.
warning.customHitboxFullCube: A custom hitbox on a full cube has no effect. Turn off Full cube.
warning.invalidHitbox: Hitbox bounds are inverted: each maximum must be greater than its minimum.
capability.requiresRestart: Changing this requires restarting the game
game.slotsHelp: Ella reserves a fixed pool of block and item slots when the game starts; each of your entries takes one.
game.slotsFull: All slots are in use. Restart the game to free them.
blockbench.notFoundHelp: Set the path to Blockbench in Settings.
export.title: Export
export.subtitle: Turn what you have made into something you can hand to someone else.
export.blocked: Fix the errors below, then export again.
export.needsEntries: Add a block or an item first
export.resourcePackHelp: A zip you can drop straight into the resource pack folder.
export.modHelp: A ready-to-use mod with your blocks and items registered properly.
export.issue.missingTexture: A texture the model references does not exist.
export.issue.badModelJson: Its model file is not valid JSON.
plugin.title: Blockbench plugin
plugin.liveSyncHelp: Optional. Saves after each edit so the game updates without pressing Ctrl+S. Ella already syncs on a normal save.
plugin.installedDone: Plugin installed — restart Blockbench to load it
crash.title: Minecraft {version} stopped unexpectedly
crash.noReport: No crash report was written for this run.
crash.copyHint: Paste this into a bug report — it includes your versions, Java and mods.
